name: team-task-manager
description: TEAM TASK MANAGER — Smart Teamwork. Clear Tasks. Better Results. Ultra-3D 2026 full-stack team productivity platform.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
